fieldValues.title: RFC candidate: declared structural constraints (acyclicity, cardinality, uniqueness-within-scope)
fieldValues.summary: Companion to #812/#818: names the machinery SRS is missing for the rules held rather than cut — relation-graph acyclicity, cardinality (single-parent), endpoint-type restriction (allowedSourceTypes/allowedTargetTypes were retired with no successor), and the naming grammar (a one-line `pattern` addition to field.json). Notes Blueprint's RelationSpec already carries the richest vocabulary (relationType, sourceType/targetType, cardinality, required) but srs-core's blueprint validation never reads cardinality or required — the RFC's first question is whether the constraint surface lands on RelationTypeDefinition, Blueprint, or both, resolving to one home per one-way-per-goal.
fieldValues.body:
RFC candidate, companion to #812. Design-note 046 (f48d489f-2081-441f-ae7b-27e4046227b7) already named the class and recommended one RFC. The held-rule queue this RFC would satisfy: contains one-parent (RFC-042 [R2]), precedes acyclicity, and mechanism-b3c293f9's naming grammar (its version-bump table is not mechanisable and likely splits out when taken up). If declined, the held rules fall back to #818's disposition table.

Mode complex, Door 2 (new normative meaning) — gate:owner-merge when written. Not scheduled: this issue holds the question and the queue until the readability wave is done.
